proposal.reason: Main change is complete CollNet feature removal from network transport/plugin/proxy behavior (`network`). Additional substantive ownership is needed for removing the CollNet transport type and connect paths from generic rank-connection management (`transport`), deleting CollNet topology graph/preset/connect logic (`graph-search`), removing executable CollNet device-kernel specializations while keeping a reserved slot (`kernels`), disabling CollNet in cost models/algo availability while preserving stable algorithm IDs (`tuning`), and updating runtime planning/chunking/pattern selection plus tuner-callback fallback guards for unsupported CollNet selections (`enqueue`).
